name: Queens Knights
headerMeta: Golden era · Buckler Infantry (shields) · 280 leadership · T5 · S-Tier
pitch: A duelist that dominates one-on-one trades with invincible dash mechanics and strong block. Strong against low-count units but struggles against high-count formations and block-heavy units; success depends entirely on dash timing.

veterancy.label: Top Line
veterancy.body: Amya recommends as the best option.

battleRole.tips: Timing on spell 1 (double-dash invincible forward) is everything — no simple rule, learned per matchup. Occasionally press 2 first into 1 to entirely change the matchup. {1} Retreat after one dash-forward with spell 1 to preserve the unit rather than pushing deeper into a bad trade. {1}

controls.notes: Spell 1 — dashes forward twice (occasionally three times) dealing big damage; unit is completely invincible during this attack. {1} Spell 2 — small shieldbash with okay-ish damage and good block/counter effect. {1}

gaps: Pre-2026-06 rework advice: Amya guide predates the 2026-06-25 patch's core skill rework (Base Block 750→950, Block recovery 27→47, Run 'Em Through invincibility 1s→1.6s but max stab hits 3→2). Timing rules and specific matchup play may no longer apply.
